blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) has announced that it is now accepting applications for key leadership positions in the Bangsamoro Government. In an official announcement released on Monday, the BARMM government asked all interested applicants for minister, deputy minister (DM), head of office, and deputy head of office positions to submit their application papers. Applicants must submit a Letter of Intent, an updated Personal Data Sheet (PDS), and a Work Experience Sheet (WES).
